advantagesAndTradeoffs.omniRemover: No comparative product advantage verified. Directory suggests uninstall intent only; obtain official evidence before recommendation or direct-substitute framing.
advantagesAndTradeoffs.breathingRoomPotentialFit: Editorial judgment based on current capabilities.md: storage exploration and grouped app/process investigation may suit understanding ongoing growth rather than retiring an app. Not evidence of superiority or full app uninstall parity.
advantagesAndTradeoffs.breathingRoomCaveats: We build Breathing Room. Register identifies 0.1.0-preview.1, macOS 13+, advertised universal installer with physical Intel untested, Apple Development signing without Developer ID/notarization, Python 3.10+ requirement, permission-limited inventory, internet/account for hosted AI, and advertised $5 USD/month or $50 USD/year optional AI Care with tax/renewal conditions. These are reused October 21 documentary findings, not a new installer test or entitlement audit. Ordinary approval, optional automatic verified Ruff-cache mode and daily saved approvals differ; do not promise unconditional per-action prompting. App must remain running for daily care.
advantagesAndTradeoffs.pricingComparison: No cheaper/free competitor conclusion possible without verified Omni purchase terms. Refresh volatile offers within 30 days and before publication if overdue.
